execution_policy: One primary review task and at most one bivariate task, serially under existing locks. Remaining budget is reserve, not permission for automatic expansion.

priorities.title: Bind an exp proof obligation to its exact implementation branch
priorities.reason: Current tests do not establish correspondence between the proof generator and the operations actually executed.
priorities.next_action: Pin exp_proof separately, map one directed FastTwoSum obligation, and record whether the historical candidate is applicable, superseded, withdrawn or still open with conditions.
priorities.deliverable: A source-to-model map, conditional certificate or precise unresolved premise, with an optional reviewed minimal patch.
priorities.acceptance: Independent review and exact source/operation binding; no claim of complete exp correctness. Gate later sine work on source stability and a named obligation.
priorities.stop: Checkpoint on source change, missing premise, failed certificate or cap; preserve the old proposal without repeatedly requesting maintainer action.
priorities.dependency: Current implementation/proof source and certificate tools; the WIP branch is not assumed to match master.
priorities.change: October 25 source review is the last scientific checkpoint. The next deliverable was defined October 26; no new scientific progress on this obligation yet.

priorities.title: Resolve asin cast and integer-range portability
priorities.reason: The passing Clang corpus does not establish signed-subtraction safety or equivalence on LP64 and LLP64.
priorities.next_action: Analyze reachable integer ranges for the changed casts/subtraction; add bounded sanitizer and ABI checks where the compiler configuration is qualified.
priorities.deliverable: A range/ABI note with tests and either a minimized reachable failure and tested remedy, or a justified defined-behavior/equivalence result for the stated domain.
priorities.acceptance: Tests alone do not prove absence of UB. Explicitly distinguish source undefined behavior, compiler miscompilation and unsupported ABI execution.
priorities.stop: Checkpoint on an unqualified ABI, unresolved range premise, source change or cap; do not label unsupported execution a failure.
priorities.dependency: Pinned asin source; qualified toolchains and a small reproducible test harness.
priorities.change: Four-mode Clang full-corpus regression passed; portability analysis remains open.

priorities.title: Build independently checkable bivariate regression evidence, hypot first
priorities.reason: The unary suite does not cover the much larger two-input space; small exact certificates can separate generating difficult cases from verifying them.
priorities.next_action: P3a qualification complete for the restricted fixtures. Next assess one bounded candidate-construction task and pinned-corpus deduplication; requalify after tool/source/profile changes. P3b archive import/reproduction stays blocked until the package is supplied.
priorities.deliverable: A standalone exact checker, explicit certificate format and separately qualified four-mode runner; later a hashed archive-import/reproduction receipt.
priorities.acceptance: Exact input decoding, positive/negative controls and bounds; values, flags and errno separate. Table verification does not regenerate a completeness census. No new bug or novelty claim from a hard-but-correct case.
priorities.stop: Stop on a failed control or cap. Recheck archive availability at the next checkpoint, report the blocker once and continue independent infrastructure work; do not silently drop the requested import.
priorities.dependency: Independent verifier and Linux adapter qualified for listed GCC/Clang profiles only. Prior archives are still unavailable; their results remain unverified here.
priorities.change: October26: implemented exact-integer verifier; 18 fixtures in four modes pass GCC/Clang and two MPFR paths, with specific negative controls. No search, completeness census or archive import.
